dashboard.label: TA-journald Overview
dashboard.description: Collects journald log-plane metadata: journal disk usage (journalctl --disk-usage), journal file count under /var/log/journal, total journal size, age of the oldest journal file,

search.query: index=main sourcetype="journald:status" | stats latest(_time) as "Last seen", count as Reports by host | table host "Last seen" Reports
| mcatalog values(metric_name) as m where index=metrics metric_name="journald.*" | eval count=mvcount(m)
index=main sourcetype="journald:status" _raw="*alarm*" | sort - _time | table _time host _raw | rename _raw as Event | head 200
